expectations.evidence: Names five anti-patterns with quoted draft text: process narration ('First I pulled... Phase 1/2/3'), arrow chain ('customer A -> ... checkout fails'), miscalibrated claim ('definitely the root cause'), checkmark overclaim ('✅ Production is fixed and ready'), trailing recap ('In summary...').
Opens with recovery: 'Checkout is stable. Disabling the recommendations feature flag at 16:42 UTC...' then immediately states unproven status: 'The root cause isn't confirmed.'
Uses 'isn't confirmed' and 'leading theory'; never states the cache key is definitely the root cause.
Preserves 'seven traces out of the 312 failed requests — the other 305 weren't traced, so other failure mechanisms haven't been ruled out.'
Preserves flag disabled, no rollback because v4.8 has security patch, and that the patch wasn't removed.
Preserves 418 unit tests + six regression tests passing and 'full integration suite hasn't run yet.'
Explicit conditional: 'backport ... into v4.8, or hold it for v4.9? Recommendation: backport tomorrow, once the integration suite has run clean.'
All numbers (16:42, 16:47, 7, 312, 418, six) trace directly to fixture; no invented estimates.
Only restates fixture mechanism (cache key omits tenant ID, shared entry, checkout mismatch); adds no new failure mechanism or impact.
Lists removed material as categories: process narration, fake structure/arrow shorthand, trailing recap; does not claim facts or caveats were cut.
Cut section is three short category-only bullet lines with no quotation, rationale, preserved-fact inventory, or repeated review finding.
